item: Author identities, roll and examination numbers
why: Required by cover/certificate/acknowledgement; none were supplied.
exact_input: Each module team and master coordinator must supply exact official names, roll numbers, exam numbers and approved team size/ownership.
suggested_source: College roster / examination record / team allocation

why: Template requires named/signature fields; repository names are not author approvals.
exact_input: Guide/department office must confirm full names, designations, actual signatories and whether the template HOD name is current.

why: The draft certificate is deliberately unsigned; successful certification cannot be inferred.
exact_input: Guide/HOD/examiner must approve title/content, provide actual signing date/place if different and sign only after review.

item: Approved report/project title and module allocations
why: Source gives seven functional modules, not official student-team assignments.
exact_input: Coordinator must approve enterprise title, exact module titles and master-report authorship.

why: SQL objects were inspected but not run in this audit.
exact_input: DB owner must execute on a disposable authorized DB and supply sanitized version/sql_mode/timezone, object counts, constraints and procedure/trigger/view results. No credentials should be sent.

why: Expected outcomes are not actual test evidence.
exact_input: Each module owner must run assigned test IDs, record preconditions/inputs/actual/status and attach sanitized before/after/error evidence.
suggested_source: Test matrix and disposable fixture scripts

why: Old admission signature and assertion-result capture gaps prevent a pass claim.
exact_input: DB/API test maintainer must update signature/expectations, expose SQL assertion rows, fail on assertion FAIL and rerun all suites.

why: Six repository screenshots use synthetic intercepted APIs and are not live DB proof.
exact_input: Module owners must capture own approved synthetic test sessions with screen/route, fixture ID, timestamp, test ID and matching network/DB evidence; mask tokens and personal details.

item: Approved attendance, exam and grading policy
why: Per-exam/global thresholds, EXCUSED rules and repeat-attempt formulae differ.
exact_input: Academic/exam coordinator must supply approved denominator/no-record/threshold/exemption/dues/publication/SGPA/CGPA/repeat-attempt rules.

why: Partial refund and concurrency paths are incomplete.
exact_input: Finance module owner and guide must approve bill components/currency/late fees/full-partial refund caps, idempotency and reconciliation expectations.

item: Hostel hierarchy, year and operational-state policy
why: Physical bed uniqueness/year semantics and cross-hostel moves are not settled.
exact_input: Hostel owner must define occupancy period, transfer rules, maintenance/reservation handling and finance linkage; repair guards and run tests.

why: PF/tax/LOP and pending leave formulas are project assumptions.
exact_input: HR/payroll owner must provide authorized salary/leave policy, PF source, cross-month proration, leave-year mapping and immutable paid-adjustment rules.
suggested_source: Approved HR rules; not legal advice from demo code

why: Role gates do not establish session, student, payslip or report-key ownership.
exact_input: Security/module leads must approve and implement role-plus-row scope and run negative access tests for identified gaps.

why: Source defaults differ from PICT 2026-2027 report context.
exact_input: Team DB administrator must approve institutional display settings and actual 2026-2027 academic_years/semesters/is_current configuration.

why: URLs/configuration are present but deployment was not validated.
exact_input: Deployment owner must supply sanitized build/health/API/CORS/nested-refresh/TLS logs for the intended environment and distinguish MySQL from Compose MariaDB.
suggested_source: CI/CD and hosting logs, no env secret values

why: Repository does not establish validated capacity or restore success.
exact_input: Operations/test lead must specify target CPU/RAM/storage/browser scale, workload, latency/error criteria and backup/restore evidence.
suggested_source: Approved deployment spec / load and restore logs

why: Local AI is default; LLM/Mongo/payment/email integrations are not verified.
exact_input: Integration owner must confirm which optional providers are required, data consent/retention and sanitized provider/fallback evidence.
suggested_source: Approved integration configuration and privacy policy

item: Final Word typography/TOC and print review
why: DOCX and revised static rendering use Times New Roman; final team-side Microsoft Word print verification is still required.
exact_input: Document coordinator must open in Word with Times New Roman installed, update all fields/TOC/lists and verify A4 pagination, captions and signatures before submission.
suggested_source: Microsoft Word print preview / supplied templates

why: Templates request references but do not establish a complete citation convention.
exact_input: Guide should confirm any required citation style; current package uses stable numeric R/T/D references and commit-pinned paths.
